label: validate-ci-entry-and-metadata-label-equivalence
command: import subprocess,pathlib,hashlib; subprocess.run(["python3","-m","compileall","-q","tools"],check=True); subprocess.run(["python3","tools/build_system_overlay.py","research/candidates/mi8937-os4/system","config/compatibility_matrix.5.xml","/tmp/wayne-ci-overlay.tar","--device-matrix","config/compatibility_matrix.device.wayne.xml","--metadata","research/candidates/mi8937-os4/inode-metadata.json"],check=True); a=pathlib.Path("/tmp/wayne-ci-overlay.tar").read_bytes(); b=pathlib.Path("artifacts/experimental/overlay.tar").read_bytes(); assert a==b,"Metadata label mode changed overlay"; subprocess.run(["python3","tools/test_installer_offline.py"],check=True); print("CI entry compiles; overlay byte-equivalence verified.")
action: 检查云端构建入口语法，并验证从 inode 清单读取标签不会改变现有适配内容。
outcome: 构建入口语法检查通过；新方式生成的 overlay 与既有 overlay 完全相同，原安装工具的 7 项离线回归仍通过。
failure_note: 云端入口或标签等价性检查失败，先修复后再启动。
next_step: 上传云端工作流并启动实际构建，跟踪每阶段进展和发布结果。
